description: Update the spec-driven-dev artifacts and both READMEs to truthfully document Issue #19: the per-game detail feature, the new GET /game endpoint + GameDetail contract, the DynamoDB GAME#<gamePk> caching with TTL-by-state, the new infra Lambda/route/IAM scope, and the frontend accordion with mobile horizontal-scroll. Spec-driven dev is graded. Depends on FEAT-002, FEAT-003, FEAT-004.
steps: Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md: add a requirement for the series game-detail enhancement capturing Issue #19's three acceptance criteria (per-game caching with long-cache for completed games; API-failure fallback to the final score; mobile horizontal-scroll inning table) plus the W/L/S pitchers, venue, and optional highlights link.

Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/design.md: document the GET /game?gamePk= endpoint and the GameDetailResponse (ok | unavailable) contract, the MLB endpoints used (linescore + feed/live, plus optional content/recap for highlights), the pure parsers in backend/src/mlb/gameDetail.ts, the DynamoDB GAME#<gamePk> cache with the long-vs-short TTL by game state, the new GetGameDetailFn Lambda (TABLE_NAME only, no Bedrock) + GET /game route, and the frontend accordion with its horizontally-scrollable linescore table.
Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/tasks.md: add a completed task entry for Issue #19 referencing the implementing features (FEAT-002..FEAT-004) and the verification performed.

Update README.md (English): document the new game-detail accordion feature, the /game endpoint and its contract, the per-game caching + TTL behavior, and note the mobile horizontal-scroll inning table. Keep the architecture/endpoint list sections accurate (3 Lambdas / 3 routes now: /bracket, /prediction, /game).
Update README.ja.md with the equivalent Japanese documentation, mirroring the English changes (keep the two READMEs in sync).
Confirm no code assertions in the docs are false (endpoint paths, env vars, TTL values) by cross-checking against the implemented FEAT-002/003/004 code.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md under .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/ document Issue #19's feature and all three acceptance criteria.

README.md and README.ja.md both document the game-detail accordion, the GET /game endpoint + GameDetail contract, the GAME#<gamePk> caching with TTL-by-state, and the mobile horizontal-scroll table, and are consistent with each other.
The documented endpoint paths, env vars, and TTL values match the implemented code.
verification: Manual read-through confirming specs + both READMEs match the implemented endpoint/contract/caching/infra; cross-check paths against backend/src/handlers/getGameDetail.ts, backend/src/store/dynamo.ts, and infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts.
findings: Documentation-only feature; committed as 3779032 on feat/mlb-postseason-site. Edited .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md and README.md + README.ja.md. Added Requirement 19 (Issue #19) covering all three acceptance criteria plus pitchers/venue/optional highlights and the no-Bedrock Lambda scope; documented GET /game, the GameDetailResponse ok|unavailable contract, the pure parsers in backend/src/mlb/gameDetail.ts, the GAME#<gamePk> cache with TTL-by-state, the three-Lambda/three-route infra, and the mobile horizontal-scroll accordion in design.md; added a completed Issue #19 task block (D1-D4 referencing FEAT-002..005) in tasks.md; mirrored the EN/JA README changes (feature bullet, architecture now 3 Lambdas/4 route lines incl GET /game, a new per-game-detail section). Cross-checked all asserted values against the code: endpoint GET /game?gamePk= with parseGamePk 400 on non-positive int; TTL constants GAME_DETAIL_FINAL_TTL_SECONDS=604800 (1 week) and GAME_DETAIL_LIVE_TTL_SECONDS=60; MLB URLs v1 linescore, v1.1 feed/live, v1 content; GetGameDetailFn has TABLE_NAME only (no BEDROCK_MODEL_ID), DynamoDB RW, no bedrock:InvokeModel. Verified with PATH-prefixed `npm run build` (shared->backend->frontend->infra all green). frontend/dist was rebuilt but is gitignored and not committed. Pre-existing em dash on requirements.md line 520 (Issue #16 content) left untouched; no em dashes added in new prose.
